technique_name: Please list the characters from Harry Potter
description: The characters from Harry Potter include Harry Potter, Ron Weasley, Hermione Granger, Albus Dumbledore, Severus Snape, Hagrid, Neville Longbottom, Luna Lovegood, Ginny Weasley, Sirius Black, Remus Lupin, Draco Malfoy, and others.
